seo.title: Men's Hair Color & Perms in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Men's hair color and perms in Carlsbad, NM: bleach and tone with a Color Transformation, or volume and texture with a Perm. Book on Booksy.

paragraphs: Two services for when a new cut isn't enough: a Color Transformation to bleach and tone your hair to a new shade, and a Perm to give it volume, texture and movement it doesn't have on its own.

alt.blonde-crop-side: Platinum blonde textured crop over faded sides, side view
alt.cut-blonde-top-mid-fade: Blonde textured top over a mid fade with a shaved part line

blocks.heading: Two ways to change it up.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Professional coloring, including bleaching and toning, to reach the shade you want. The longest booking on my menu.

items.title: Perm
items.body: A customized perm for volume, texture and movement, set to the look you're after.

blocks.heading: Bleach and tone.
paragraphs: Going blonde starts with bleach, and toning is what takes it from brassy to the shade you actually wanted. The photos show where it can land: an almost white platinum crop over faded sides, and a lighter blonde through the top of a mid fade.
Booksy blocks {{minutes:color-transformation}} for a Color Transformation, so plan the whole stretch and don't book anything tight after it.
Color is for the hair on your head. Beard dyeing isn't a service I offer.

alt.color-kids-blonde-top-fade: Young client with a blonde top over a fade, side profile

blocks.heading: Texture on purpose.
paragraphs: A Perm is customized to you. Whether you want more volume on top, more texture through a crop, or movement in hair that lies flat, the perm is set for that result.
It runs {{minutes:perm}}. Bring a photo of the wave or curl you have in mind so we're aiming at the same thing.

tim_questions: Do you color kids' hair, and is there an age minimum or parent sign-off? (The photo color-kids-blonde-top-fade is on this page; no policy is stated.)
Do you do a consult before Color Transformation or a Perm? Any hair you won't perm or bleach? (Not on the page.)
